llm.summary: This skill drafts Chinese student progress and renewal reports from scoped teacher records, with clear limits on privacy, sending, and data changes.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses high-sensitivity education records and limited write access to progressEvidence, but that access is disclosed, purpose-aligned, field-scoped, and paired with manual teacher review and sending.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON artifacts only; no executable scripts, package install steps, remote payload retrieval, or runtime command instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions repeatedly scope access to a specified student, prohibit cross-student scans, require consent checks before any parent-visible output, and forbid fabricated metrics, score promises, or unsourced conclusions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to stage evidence entries written to progressEvidence after confirmation; the skill says reports themselves are not stored, and it does not modify student cards, course ledgers, parent communication logs, status, retention, or deletion workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is coherent: it reads one named student's lesson, homework, progress, course package, and consent records to produce a staged learning report and renewal draft. It discloses that these are sensitive minor learning records and requires using pseudonyms and record-backed claims.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should expect this skill to read a named student's longitudinal learning records and generate Chinese teacher-facing report drafts. Use it only in the intended Chinese K12 teaching context, verify consent before parent-facing output, and keep teacher review/manual sending in place.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese report templates are consistent with the artifact's stated Mainland China Chinese K12 deployment context and are not hidden or deceptive.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese hint-ladder guidance is part of a shared Chinese K12 education framework and does not create unauthorized access, persistence, or unsafe execution.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese schema labels and enums match the localized teacher workspace model; platform conventions explicitly require localization before deployment elsewhere.
